title: test(app-shell): await the flow label in the canvas-chip header test
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAoNwrZVJoUEFfvMURpRPKJ)_

Fixes #37822
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感:只改一条自动化测试,产品界面不变。
- 让流程画布标题测试不再偶发失败(测试在标题加载完成前就去读文字)。
- 出错只会让这条测试误报,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes
`StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx` only. The canvas chip prints the API name until the flow loads (`flowTitle = current ? ... : flowName`), so the synchronous label and header-text reads after `caption()` raced the load. They now sit in `waitFor`. The fixture gains a `server.gate` that holds `list`/`layered`; a new case proves the chip is the API-name placeholder while held and the label after release; the API-name fallback case releases the gate and waits for `auto-flow-meta` so it no longer passes on the placeholder.

## Tests
- File: 5/5 pass; 20 consecutive runs: 20 ok.
- Ablation (header prints API name, `flowTitle = flowName`, reverted): zh, en and the new late-load case go red; the API-name case stays green by design (it is the fallback).
- Old synchronous read vs late load: the new case asserts the placeholder while held, which is what the old sync assertion would have read.

## Acceptance notes
No changeset: test file ships in no package. Header text reads (zh hint, en 'Visual orchestration') also sat synchronously; now awaited.
